sections.MESSAGE_TO_USER:
**mboetger left three inline comments on [#196561](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561) a few minutes before he approved it. I recommend merging now and fixing all three in a small follow-up PR.**

mboetger is a human reviewer, so I won't post replies to him. My drafts for you to post are below.

**Comment 1: [`toBigIntegerOrNull()` nit](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561#discussion_r4606831206).** He's right that the shorter call exists. One catch: as I remember the Kotlin stdlib, `toBigIntegerOrNull()` returns `null` for a leading `+`, while `BigInteger("+5")` returns 5. So the swap may change behavior slightly. I'm asking matt561 to check the stdlib source and add a test before making the change. This is cleanup, not a bug fix.

**Comments 2 and 3: [the "refuses to install" thread](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561#discussion_r4606860038).** He's right, and our KDoc overstates it:
- **What's actually true:** An APK with no `versionCode` installs fine with `adb` on a clean device. It fails when you upload it to the Play Store, or when you install it over a build that has a `versionCode`.
- **What doesn't change:** The design still holds. The error still shouldn't suggest `force-version-code-ignoring-abi`, because that flag produces APKs you can't ship or use to update an installed app. Only the wording is wrong.
- **What I still have to check:** I'm reading the diff to see whether the printed error message, the tests or the PR description make the same claim. If the text users see says "Android refuses to install", that's a false message going into 3.50 and 3.51, and I'll come back to you before you merge.

I haven't re-run `pr_triage.dart` or re-fetched the review threads this turn. I'll do both before you act, in case anything new was posted.

**Decision: how to handle the three comments**
- **1a (recommended):** Merge #196561 now, either yourself or by me adding `autosubmit` as you. matt561 opens a follow-up PR with both fixes. If the follow-up only touches the KDoc and the equivalent refactor, it doesn't need cherry-picking.
- **1b:** Push both fixes to #196561 first. This dismisses all three approvals, reruns about an hour of presubmits, and needs fresh approvals from reidbaker, bkonyi and mboetger, so the 3.50 and 3.51 cherry-picks wait.

Meanwhile, matt561 is preparing the fixes on a separate branch that doesn't touch the PR, so either option is fast.

**Draft replies for you to post** (I'll fill in the follow-up number):

> Thread r4606831206: Good call. Switching to `toBigIntegerOrNull()` in #NNNN, so this PR keeps its approvals and CI for the 3.50/3.51 cherry-picks. (Checking first that it handles a leading `+` the same way as `BigInteger(String)`.)

> Thread r4606860038: You're right, "refuses to install" overstates it. A fresh `adb install` works. What fails is uploading to Play and installing over a build that has a `versionCode`. That's still why the error doesn't suggest `force-version-code-ignoring-abi`: its APKs can't ship or update an existing install. Rewording the KDoc in #NNNN.

Reply "go" to accept 1a, and I'll add `autosubmit` once I've confirmed the printed error text is fine.
sections.WORKER_BRIEF:
<WORKER-BRIEF>

**Task: prepare a follow-up for review comments on flutter/flutter#196561. Do NOT push to the PR branch.**

**Background.** #196561 ("Fix --split-per-abi versionCode when android {} omits versionCode") has three approvals and green CI. Any push to `vcfix-manifest-fallback` dismisses the approvals and reruns about an hour of presubmits. That would delay the 3.50/3.51 cherry-picks. So do everything on a new branch.

**Setup.**
- Create a branch `vcfix-review-followups` from `vcfix-manifest-fallback` at `f3d2ab1fd3b`.
- Push it only to the `reidbaker-agent` fork.
- Do not open a PR yet. I'll tell you whether it becomes a follow-up PR or gets cherry-picked onto the PR branch.

**Review comments from mboetger (human reviewer), verbatim:**

Comment 1, `ManifestVersionCodeTaskHelper.kt` line 113, https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561#discussion_r4606831206
> nit: toBigIntegerOrNull() exists

It is on:
```kotlin
val versionCode =
    try {
        BigInteger(value)
    } catch (e: NumberFormatException) {
        null
    }
```

Comments 2 and 3, one thread on `ManifestVersionCodeTaskHelper.kt` line 152, https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561#discussion_r4606860038
> I don't think this is true.  Can't submit to Play Store sure - but I was able to install with adb.

> I believe it will reject if you try to install over a build with a versionCode.

That thread is on the `errorMessage` KDoc. The KDoc says that with `force-version-code-ignoring-abi`, a manifest with no positive `versionCode` "builds APKs with no `versionCode`, which Android refuses to install."

**What to do.**

1. **Comment 1.**
   - Replace the try/catch with `value.toBigIntegerOrNull()`, but only if behavior stays the same for every input that matters.
   - Read the Kotlin stdlib source for `String.toBigIntegerOrNull()` and compare it with `BigInteger(String)`. Check a leading `+`, a leading `-`, the empty string, whitespace and non-ASCII digits. I believe `"+5"` gives `null` from one and 5 from the other. Confirm or refute that from the source.
   - If behavior differs, decide which result is correct for a manifest `versionCode`, add a unit test for that case, and report the difference to me.

2. **Comments 2 and 3.**
   - Reword the KDoc to the accurate claim: an APK with no `versionCode` can be installed with `adb` on a clean device, but Play rejects it, and installing it over a build that has a `versionCode` fails. Keep the conclusion that the error must not suggest the flag.
   - Don't state why the over-install fails (for example "treated as 0, so it's a downgrade") unless you've verified it against AOSP source or by testing.
   - If an emulator is available, test it: build a project whose manifest has no `versionCode` with `-P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true`, `adb install` it fresh, then install it over a build that has a `versionCode`. Record the exact adb output for both. If you can't test, say so.

3. **Find every copy of the claim.** Search the whole PR diff (`git diff origin/main...f3d2ab1fd3b`) for the same claim: the user-facing error string, tests, other comments, the PR description. List every location. **Tell me right away if the user-facing error text contains it, before you finish the rest.** That decides whether the PR merges as-is.

4. **Run the tests.** Run the Flutter Gradle plugin's Kotlin unit tests that cover `ManifestVersionCodeTaskHelper`, plus the related `flutter_tools` tests. Paste the commands and results.

5. **Don't reply on GitHub.** mboetger is a human reviewer, so don't post anything on these threads.

**Report back with:**
- the branch name and head SHA
- the diff
- the stdlib comparison result
- the adb results, or why you couldn't test
- every location of the claim
- test output
